historical_record.description: 1280 Ellis Street was a fully occupied twelve-unit apartment building, three floors over a twelve-car garage, built as one of six twelve-unit buildings known as the Laguna Heights Apartments; after foreclosure it was held by the Federal Housing Administration.
The City Planning Commission approved a tentative condominium subdivision map for the twelve-unit 1280 Ellis Street Apartments.
